vignette: A school-aged child who is deaf presents for a first dental visit. The caregiver reports that the child becomes anxious in unfamiliar settings.
stem: Which approach to planning this visit best reflects current guidance for patients with sensory impairment?

options.text: Use the same communication style and operatory setup that is used for every other new patient.
Use alternative communication methods, adapt the environment, and individualize the approach to this child.
Assume the hearing impairment will have no effect on how care is delivered.
Apply one uniform protocol, reserving individualized approaches for patients with behavioral challenges only.
